name: Reqode
tagline: Controlled and predictable AI-driven software development.
description: Reqode is a platform for controlled and predictable AI-driven software development. Product engineers and development teams define whole features, give AI coding agents connected product and architecture context, and verify implementation against specifications. Reqode connects requirements, data models, UI and API specs, code and tests. AI assistants support analysis, architecture and test design, and MCP connects coding and QA agents. Available in the cloud or self-hosted.
startingPrice: $19 per user/month for Reqode Cloud after a 14-day trial
